tagline: Shared shopping lists that know what they cost and how long the warranty runs.
description:
Shopping List keeps as many lists as you need, with quantities and prices per item and a running total of what is bought and what is left. Lists can be shared with other Apps Hub accounts, so a household adds to the same list from different devices.

Marking an item as bought can take its cost straight out of a Budget category, and un-marking it puts the money back — useful for a household budget where the weekly shop should just book itself.

Items you bought do not simply vanish. They move into a history, and anything with a warranty can be given a start and end date and photos of the receipt or the item, so when something breaks two years later you can find the proof in seconds.
capabilities: Multiple named lists, each with its own items.
Quantity and price per product, with bought / remaining / total shown live.
Share a list with other Apps Hub accounts, add members from your favourites, remove them again.
History of everything bought, kept even after the list is deleted.
Warranty tracking with start and end dates and a countdown to expiry.
Photo attachments per warranty — receipts, serial numbers, the item itself.
Public web page for your Apps Hub account.

integrations.name: Budget
integrations.summary: Give an item a Budget category and marking it bought withdraws its cost from that category. Un-marking it reverts the withdrawal. If Budget is unavailable the item is still marked bought and you are told the deduction did not go through.
integrations.requires: Budget installed, and its App API enabled in Apps Hub → Settings → App APIs. The switch is off by default.
